# Gabriel Maglia

> Fullstack developer based in Argentina, frontend-focused. He designs and builds web, mobile and desktop applications end to end: product thinking, interface design, implementation and production deployment. Available for projects.

The portfolio is a single page per language: https://www.gabrielmaglia.me/en (English) and https://www.gabrielmaglia.me/es (Spanish). Both carry the same content: about, stack, selected work, experience and contact.

## Selected work

- [Global Traffic](https://globaltraffic.earth): the planet's trade on a 3D globe (sea, air and land routes, industrial plants, satellites) built on public data (CEPII, World Bank, Climate TRACE). Web app, 2026. Next.js, Three.js, TypeScript, Python. Designed and built end to end.
- [HushSplit](https://www.gabrielmaglia.me/apps/hushsplit/): split expenses with friends, end-to-end encrypted; the server stores data it cannot read. Mobile app, 2026. Expo, React Native, TypeScript, Supabase. Designed and built end to end.
- [Net-Gauge](https://www.gabrielmaglia.me/apps/netgauge/): real-time network usage per app on Windows and Mac. Free and open source. Desktop app, 2026. Python. Designed and built end to end.
- Photo Cut: removes image backgrounds and generates full app icon sets, on-device. Web and desktop app, 2026. React.
- Gimnasio Craneo: landing page for a gym, built from scratch. 2022. React.
- Chevromax: maintenance work, component fixes and a Heroku server stack update. 2024. Vue, Express.
